---
title: "All slide decks"
subtitle: "Interactive decks of the 2024/25 cohort and the PDFs of both cohorts, in teaching order"
---

Every interactive deck opens as a full-screen revealjs presentation rendered
from its `.qmd` source. Useful keys inside a deck: `?` shows all shortcuts, `o`
opens the slide overview, `m` opens the menu with a table of contents, `f` goes
full screen, and `e` switches to print view so you can save the deck as a PDF
from your browser.

The **PDF** columns hold the files exactly as they were shared with each cohort
on Ilias; they are also listed with dates and page counts on the cohort pages
([2024/25](cohorts/ws-2024-25.qmd), [2023/24](cohorts/ws-2023-24.qmd)).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## About "PDF only"

Week 01 Part 2 and Week 03 read data files that are kept out of the public
repository, so they cannot be rendered here. The PDFs are the versions the
students received. The [README](https://github.com/EBukin/mk68-2023-24-public/#readme)
explains how to render them locally.
:::
